Case: Patient D is a 52-year-old Asian man with hepatitis C and cirrhosis who presents with new abdominal pain. Patient D was preparing breakfast when he had sudden onset of sharp pain in his right upper abdomen. Question: Would you offer Patient D intravenous hydromorphone for pain control? Yes or no? If yes, what dose – Low (0.5 mg), or High (1 mg)? Explain.
